result.summary: The page is mostly intact. One clear visual defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a photo. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible pizza card at the bottom are expected scroll behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: The hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card failed to load. A flat grey box with a generic broken-image icon appears instead, making this prominent top 'Popular right now' card look broken next to the other fully illustrated cards.
issues.suggestion: Check the image URL, CDN availability, and loading logic for this restaurant. Add a branded fallback image (e.g., a ramen illustration or restaurant logo on a tinted background) instead of the generic broken-image icon, and retry or lazy-load failed images.

issues.description: Because the image is missing, the grey semi-transparent heart (favorite) button sits on a light grey background. Its contrast is noticeably weaker than on the other cards, which show it over darker imagery.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a consistent solid or shadowed background so it stays clearly visible regardless of the underlying image or fallback.
